verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms core building blocks — audience targeting via tags/segments/date filters (bento-docs-8, bento-docs-26) and the ability to 'create broadcasts' via MCP/CLI (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-17) — implying campaign sending exists, but there's no direct documentation of the campaign composer UI or scheduling mechanics for a broadcast/campaign send. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the email campaign editor, audience picker UI, and scheduling/send-now workflow with independent confirmation it works end-to-end.
